title: 第一卷 第3章 俘获芳心第一卷 第4章 暗情涌动
slug: 老来娶妻的我打造出最强仙族
lines: “真美！”
“仙姿绝色惹人醉！”
林逸看着醉仙坊，柜台后面坐着的绝美女子，看得有些痴了。
这仙女模样的女子，看上去三十来岁，身穿淡青色罗裙，袖口挽到小臂，露出一截雪白的手腕。
一双桃花眼微微上挑，眼波流转间，带着三分妩媚，三分精明，还有三分说不清的风情。
“夫君，这就是你说的好地方？”
“你想看美人，自己偷偷过来便是，何必拉着我一起？”
“我才是你刚过门的妻子，你这么明目张胆，肆无忌惮，完全不把我放在心上是么？”
柳婉儿看一眼醉仙坊的妩媚女掌柜，心下吃醋，用力狠狠掐了一下林逸的手臂，气哼哼道。
论容貌。
论身材。
论胸。
她都不输这妩媚女掌柜。
“婉儿，轻点！”
“你想哪里去了？”
“我带你来这醉仙坊，是来学酿酒的！”
林逸手臂吃痛，疼得龇牙咧嘴，连忙道明真实意图。
“学酿酒？”
“这还差不多！”
柳婉儿立即转怒为喜，俏皮一笑，挽着林逸的手臂，走进醉仙坊。
“这老头，娶了个这么年轻的妻子！”
“在醉仙坊门前，打情骂俏起来了！”
“这老头，还能耕耘地动么？”
繁华街道上，过往的行人，看着挽手而行的林逸和柳婉儿，忍不住酸溜溜道。
满头白发的年迈老头，身穿绿裙的绝美少女，这反差太大，着实让人艳羡。
醉仙坊中，酒香扑鼻。
“掌柜的，叨扰了！”
“不知贵酒坊，是否收酿酒学徒？”
“我这妻子柳婉儿，即将踏上仙路，她精通酿制凡酒，有酿酒底子！”
林逸走上前去，看着这位娇媚动人的女掌柜，拱手笑问道。
要想将林氏一族，打造成强大的仙族，
光靠种田肯定不够，光靠他一个人赚钱，更是远远不够。
他要将柳婉儿，培养成酿酒师。
在种田之外，再额外开辟出酿酒这条赚钱路子。
这样才有机会，抗衡修仙斩杀线。
避免被赵猛这种不怀好意的歹徒，一心盯着吃绝户。
“当然收酿酒学徒！”
“不过要两块下品灵石的学费，保证教会三种灵酒的酿法，要学么？”
曲嫣然打量着眼前这对反差极大的老夫少妻，盈盈笑道。
“这么贵！”
content_en:
"So beautiful!"
"The beauty of the fairy is so intoxicating!"
Lin Yi looked at Zuixianfang, the beautiful woman sitting behind the counter, and was a little fascinated.
This fairy-like woman looks to be in her thirties. She is wearing a light blue skirt. The cuffs are rolled up to her forearms, revealing a section of her snow-white wrists.
A pair of peach blossom eyes are slightly raised, and as their eyes move, they are one-third charming, one-third shrewd, and one-third indescribable amorous feelings.
"Husband, is this the good place you said?"
"If you want to see the beauty, just come here secretly, why bother dragging me along?"
"I am your newly married wife. Are you so blatant and unscrupulous that you don't care about me at all?"
Liu Waner took one look at the charming female shopkeeper of Zuixianfang and felt jealous. She pinched Lin Yi's arm hard and groaned angrily.
On appearance.
On body shape.
On breasts.
She is not inferior to this charming female shopkeeper.
"Wan'er, be gentle!"
"Where did you want to go?"
"I brought you to this Zuixianfang to learn how to make wine!"
Lin Yi felt pain in his arm, grinning in pain, and quickly revealed his true intention.
"Learning to make wine?"
"That's pretty much it!"
Liu Waner immediately turned from anger to joy, smiled playfully, took Lin Yi's arm and walked into Zuixianfang.
"This old man married such a young wife!"
"We started flirting in front of Zuixianfang!"
"Can this old man still plow the land?"
On the bustling street, passers-by couldn't help but feel sour when they saw Lin Yi and Liu Waner walking arm in arm.
The contrast between the old man with white hair and the beautiful girl in a green dress is so great that it is really enviable.
In Zuixianfang, the aroma of wine is fragrant.
"Shopkeeper, I'm sorry for disturbing you!"
"I wonder if your winery accepts brewing apprentices?"
"My wife Liu Wan'er is about to embark on the path to immortality. She is proficient in brewing mortal wine and has the foundation to make wine!"
Lin Yi walked forward, looked at the charming female shopkeeper, cupped his hands and asked with a smile.
If you want to build the Lin clan into a powerful fairy clan,
Farming alone is certainly not enough, and it is far from enough for him to make money alone.
He wants to train Liu Wan'er to become a winemaker.
In addition to farming, another way to make money is to make wine.
Only in this way can we have a chance to compete with the Immortal Cultivating Killing Line.
Avoid being targeted by evil-intentioned gangsters like Zhao Meng.
"Of course we will accept brewing apprentices!"
"But it only requires two low-grade spiritual stones for tuition, and I promise to teach you how to brew three kinds of spiritual wine. Do you want to learn it?"
Qu Yanran looked at the contrasting old couple in front of her and said with a smile.
"So expensive!"
